data.review_body: I returned a $190 clothing item in perfect, unworn condition, but Shein only refunded me $25. They claimed the item was "defective" and provided extremely blurry, unconvincing photos alleging there was a "hair" and a "stain" on it. When I contacted customer service to dispute this ridiculous 90% deduction, the agent ("Iki") completely ignored my explicit request to speak with a supervisor. Instead, they just gave me a generic, scripted response saying they couldn't process a full refund and ended the resolution process. Withholding $165 for an item returned in its original state is completely unfair and feels like a scam. I will be initiating a chargeback with my bank. Be very careful with their return process—they will find any excuse to keep your money!
data.review_headline: Unacceptable Return Policy: Kept 90% of my refund with fake excuses!
